The pole is green with a floral wreath at the top. Dancers in traditional Morris dancing attire (white shirts, black vests with red accents, bells on legs) are holding the streamers and dancing around the pole. The background shows a brick building with 'OXFORD BOOKS' signage and colorful bunting flags strung across the street. Spectators are visible in the background.
